d: India's eastern coast is on high alert as Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan barrels towards Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. With winds expected to reach 110 kmph, heavy to extremely heavy rainfall and rough seas threaten coastal districts. More than 100,000 people have been evacuated in Odisha as disaster response teams, shelters and rescue operations are mobilised. Tamil Nadu is also preparing for rain and thunderstorms. With three named cyclonic storms emerging over the Bay of Bengal in around three weeks, questions are mounting over the region's weather patterns and preparedness. Gursshheen…
